text.en:
CIVIL LIST AND PENSION ACT
Chapter 44
Civil List and Pension Act — Resolution Passed
It is hereby notified for general information that the following resolution was passed at a meeting of Parliament on 2nd March 2010:
“That this Parliament, pursuant to section 7 of the Civil List and Pension Act (Chapter 44), resolves that the Schedule to that Act be varied by deleting the figures “$3,137,700”, “$69,000”, “$3,823,400”, “$2,015,300”, and “$598,400” in the second column and substituting the figures “$3,376,800”, “$73,000”, “$4,060,800”, “$2,093,600” and “$746,900”, respectively.”.
